notes: Security update. Closes a hole in the Files trash that could have let someone with Files access take over the hub, and makes first-time setup impossible to re-open. Links, forms and recipe imports can no longer be used to reach inside the house or act for you from another site. Kids' stars and allowance no longer go missing when a parent edits them at the same moment the chore board updates. Changing your password now signs out your other devices, and Stack Health restarts are logged with who pressed them.
